_readme: Hand-edited. Each program is a tab on /hiring. `id` must match HIRING_PROGRAMS in src/lib/site.ts and worker/src/index.ts. Set a program's or a role's `open` to false to stop taking applications for it without removing it. Role ids are sent with the application, so keep them stable once live.

programs.title: Nightjar
programs.tagline: Help build a fine-tuned model that exploits web applications well enough to win CTFs.
programs.about: Nightjar is a fine-tuned model with its own agent harness, specialised in web exploitation. We benchmark it against real CTF challenges, including our own, and the goal is simple: help MaaSec climb the rankings.
lookingFor: Curious about LLMs, agents, or web security — ideally two of the three

roles.title: ML engineer
roles.summary: Fine-tuning, training data pipelines, and evaluation runs.

roles.title: Agent / harness engineer
roles.summary: The tool-calling loop, sandboxing, and how the model drives a browser and HTTP client.

roles.title: Web exploitation specialist
roles.summary: Writing challenges and solve traces, and judging whether the model's exploits are actually right.

roles.title: Infrastructure
roles.summary: GPU access, challenge environments, and keeping benchmark runs reproducible.

programs.title: MaaSec collaboration
programs.tagline: Contribute to our open projects, or bring one of your own.
programs.about: Beyond Nightjar, members and outside collaborators work on our tooling, learning material, and research. If you want to build something with us — or have a project that needs a security team — this is the place to start.
lookingFor: Something you've built, broken, or written that you can show us
Willingness to work in the open on GitHub

roles.title: Project contributor
roles.summary: Code for Big Sister 2, MaaSec Tools, or another repository on our GitHub.

roles.title: Writeups & workshops
roles.summary: Guides, writeups, and workshop material for the Library and Workshops repos.

roles.title: Research partner
roles.summary: A joint security research project with the team.

roles.title: Something else
roles.summary: Tell us what you have in mind.
